data.one_liner: CLI tool for automating Windows installer creation using Inno Setup
data.what_it_does: Automates bundling Flutter desktop applications into Windows installers using Inno Setup. It provides commands to manage Inno Setup versions, generate configuration via pubspec.yaml, and package executables and assets.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Windows
You want to automate the creation of Windows installers using Inno Setup via a CLI tool
avoid_when: You are targeting non-Windows platforms like mobile or web
You prefer writing custom Inno Setup scripts manually without CLI automation
strengths: Simplifies Windows installer creation directly from Flutter projects
Manages Inno Setup versions locally without modifying the OS software list
Handles necessary DLL files and custom file extension associations
weaknesses: Limited only to Windows installers using Inno Setup
Requires Inno Setup dependencies on the build environment
data.setup_notes: Add inno_bundle as a dev dependency in pubspec.yaml and run dart run inno_bundle.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub add dev:inno_bundle
dart run inno_bundle
